name: Diwakar V
title: AI Backend Developer | Java | Spring Boot | Python | FastAPI | LLM Applications
tagline: Building scalable backend services, REST APIs and AI-powered applications with Python, FastAPI, Java and Spring Boot.
about: AI Backend Developer with 2.5 years of software development experience building backend services, REST APIs and AI-powered applications. I have built an AI chatbot and AI agent using GPT-4o and an MCP server for lead, client and policy scoring, and I develop custom AI agents, AI workflows and conversational features for ERP, CRM and project management applications. I'm strong in object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, API integration, RBAC, SQL query optimization, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

points: Develop backend services and RESTful APIs with Python and FastAPI for AI and intelligent automation use cases in an AI-native enterprise application (Apragya AI).
Build AI chatbots, custom AI agents and LLM-powered features that let businesses create and configure AI agents for their workflows.
Design AI workflows that let AI agents interact with application data, APIs and business processes across ERP, CRM and project management modules.
Built an AI chatbot and AI agent for InsureCRM using GPT-4o through an MCP server, so the model selects the right tool and retrieves data from the database to answer natural-language queries.
Implemented AI-driven scoring of leads, clients and insurance policies to help agents prioritize follow-ups and renewals.
Integrated third-party APIs, including the Meta WhatsApp API for automated follow-ups, plus push notifications and REST APIs for mobile access.
Design backend applications using MVC architecture, OOP, input validation, exception handling, authentication and authorization.
Write optimized SQL queries, debug and test applications, refactor legacy code, and use Git, GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control, code reviews, CI/CD and deployments.
Work in Agile/Scrum sprints with frontend developers, AI engineers, QA and product stakeholders.
